brief:
The World Food Programme is reducing food assistance to Palestinians in Gaza as winter nears, Drop Site News reported, compounding an already dire humanitarian situation. Gazans are struggling to prepare inadequate shelter—tents and damaged homes—while facing sharply diminished rations, according to accounts from the territory.

Aid organizations describe the convergence of seasonal hardship and reduced humanitarian support as catastrophic. Hunger levels are rising across the enclave as the cold months approach and supplies dwindle.
dek: As winter approaches, Palestinians in Gaza are desperately trying to prepare their tents and damaged homes while food cuts by the World Food Programme are exacerbating rising levels of hunger.
title: UN food cuts deepen hunger crisis as Gaza winter approaches
